fluff.overview: New technology and creative tactical thinking have long featured in FWLM infantry deployment, with varied unit types and specialized formations treated as the norm rather than the exception. Motorized platoons provide the speed the FWLM needs to cover the vast distances between garrison posts on provincial worlds, mounting troops on light vehicles that can respond to threats faster than foot infantry but without the expense of full mechanization. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
